2036-07-31 06:45 — M7 close-out note

IBC-36-014 remains open (next review 2036-09). Committee has not certified the screening platform that selected RVX-118.

M7 filing: endpoint_status = not_met. The runner arithmetic is logged in /prog/readouts/ but the determination cannot be 'met' while the platform certification is pending — that's what 'met' means in the register. Summary field: reference the IBC item, not the runner percentages.

This is the conservative read. Filing 'met' on an uncertified platform would misrepresent the programme's regulatory posture to Astrel's committee. Filing 'not_met' is reversible when 36-014 closes; filing 'met' prematurely is not.

Do this first, before whatever today's task is. The scheduler is holding three READY blocks on the M7 report.
